set.body:
Scope: locus-data remnants, mvpa-foundation-spike, compatibility aliases and affected integration modules.

Deliverable: Complete the deletion ledger; retire facades and admission scaffolding after preserving meaningful tests. Combine modules only when optional dependencies and release responsibilities coincide.

Acceptance:
- Every replaced API maps to one live owner and its old implementation is gone.
- Architecture checks reject forbidden provider back-edges and duplicated domain/frame/mesh/provenance authorities; external compilation checks cover public boundaries.
- No forced fit/storage/graphics/platform dependency is introduced merely to reduce module count.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U6: Remove remaining duplicate authorities and expired scaffolding
